Deployment: Accuracy and Cost

Practical discussion
Every choice has a cost side
  • Representation: embedded text plus images matches parser text plus images (50.1% against 49.5%) with fewer tokens. Images cost about 26 s of prefill against 1.8 s.
  • Retriever: ColQwen3 reaches 81.0% recall at 5 against 58.1% for BM25, but needs a GPU and 110 ms per query against 0.3 ms.
  • Reasoner: 4-bit keeps accuracy at a smaller footprint (51.8% in about 6.8 GB) but is not faster.
